$comment: Declared verifier expectations for the three receipt kinds. Schema-level cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (receipts/fixtures). The arithmetic and chaining rules below become executable with the receipt verifier.

vectors.note: loweredUnits + refusedUnits == totalUnits per category; refusals.length == sum of refusedUnits
each stage's inputDigest equals the previous stage's outputDigest; the first stage's input is the source digest
compositionHash equals the canonical hash of the ordered layers list recomputed from the receipt itself
checkpoint ticks strictly increase and the last one equals init.ticks
resumedStateHash equals the checkpoint stateHash recorded at dumpAtTick when such a checkpoint exists
